narrative.details:
<As the creature falls, its head comes toppling off. It seems as if it has been reattached several times, and the connection gets weaker with each reconnection.

Someone in the Undercity would know more about this unique abomination.>
narrative.objectives: Deliver the Abominable Head to someone within the Undercity.
narrative.offerRewardText: Oho! I believe I know this head. A cruel joke by our Dark Lady. A delicious one at that.I think I have a use for this.
